verified: The Robot Report reports a $500 million Series F led by SoftBank Group, with NVIDIA, Hitachi Group and T.Capital participating, at an $8.5 billion valuation and $2 billion total funding; Agile Robots says it has deployed 20,000 industrial robots.
unconfirmed: The round's terms, revenue, current factory utilization and a U.S. site or timeline are not disclosed; the 10,000-unit annual figure is stated capacity at an existing German plant, not current output or capacity added by this round.

verified: 据 The Robot Report 报道，Agile Robots 宣布完成 5 亿美元 F 轮融资，估值 85 亿美元、累计融资 20 亿美元；软银集团领投，英伟达、日立集团和 T.Capital 参投。
unconfirmed: 5 亿美元的具体分配、扩产和美国扩张的时间表、客户名单与订单量均未披露；85 亿美元估值、德国工厂最高 1 万台年产能和已部署 2 万台工业机器人等数字均来自公司披露，未获独立核实。

titles.en: Agile Robots raises $500M Series F at $8.5B valuation
titles.zh: Agile Robots 获 5 亿美元 F 轮融资，估值 85 亿美元
